prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a car speedometer, with the needle pointing just above 80 km/h. The composition is tight, focusing on the left half of the circular gauge, with crisp, white numerals and tick marks standing out against a deep, matte black background. The lighting is soft and natural, creating subtle reflections and a slight gradient across the glass surface, suggesting daylight filtering through a car window. The right side of the frame fades into a gentle blur, emphasizing the sharpness of the speedometer and creating a shallow depth of field. The overall color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by shades of black, grey, and hints of metallic blue, evoking a modern, sleek, and slightly suspenseful atmosphere. The image conveys a sense of motion and anticipation, as if capturing a fleeting moment during a drive.
